prerequisites.title: Kintone admin access
prerequisites.detail: Someone with User & System Administration access must create the OAuth client in each Kintone domain.

prerequisites.title: Composio custom auth config
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Kintone app, so you supply your own client ID and secret.

steps.title: Register OAuth client in Kintone
steps.detail: In User & System Administration, open OAuth under System Administration, click Add OAuth Client and fill in name and redirect endpoint, then Save.
steps.done_when: Client ID and client secret are generated.

steps.title: Enable users for the client
steps.detail: Click Configure users next to the client, check the users allowed to use it and save. New users are unchecked by default.
steps.done_when: Target users are checked and saved.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the custom auth config for kintone_rest through Composio's API with the client ID and secret and the scopes needed.

steps.title: Check redirect URI and scopes
steps.detail: Verify the redirect URI is identical in the authorization and token requests and is URL-encoded; separate multiple scopes with spaces.
steps.done_when: Test authorization completes and returns a token.

steps.title: Connect a test user
steps.detail: The end user logs in to Kintone and approves the authorization request.

traps.title: New users are disabled by default
traps.detail: A new client has no users enabled, and later-created users are also unchecked. Connections fail until the admin checks them.

traps.title: IP restrictions block OAuth clients
traps.detail: OAuth client features cannot be used from Kintone domains with IP restrictions unless the OAuth client's IP is allowlisted.

traps.title: Authorization codes expire in 10 minutes
traps.detail: If the code expires, repeat the flow from step 1. Access tokens last 1 hour; refresh tokens do not expire.

traps.title: Client and token caps
traps.detail: Up to 20 OAuth clients can be registered, and up to 10 refresh tokens per client per user.

traps.title: Authorization endpoint is per customer
traps.detail: The authorization endpoint uses the customer's own Kintone subdomain, so each domain needs its own client.

blockers.what_it_means: The client is not enabled for that user, or the domain uses IP restrictions.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the admin to check the user in Configure users and allowlist the client IP if needed.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the instructions for the customer admin.

blockers.what_it_means: The authorization code or access token has expired.
blockers.what_to_do: Repeat the authorization flow and refresh tokens before they expire.

evidence.quote: kintoneとの連携による導入実績が2件以上あること。（自社利用除く）
evidence.answer: To be listed as a certified kintone integration service, the provider needs at least 2 customer deployments via kintone integration, excluding in-house use (one suffices for semi-order kintone app packages).

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: ユーザーに誤解を与えるサービス名称/ロゴではないこと。
evidence.answer: Use restriction: the service name and logo must not mislead users.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: 既に認定されているkintone連携サービス名と重複しないこと。
evidence.answer: Use restriction: the service name must not duplicate an already-certified kintone integration service name.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: cybozu developer network で公開しているAPIのみを使用していること。
evidence.answer: Eligibility/use restriction: the integration may only use APIs published on cybozu developer network.

evidence.question: G11
evidence.quote: お客様が購入可能な商品単位であること。 （料金プラン、ユースケース、または機能単位での認定は不可とする）
evidence.answer: Eligibility rule: the certified unit must be a customer-purchasable product; certification by pricing plan, use case, or feature alone is not allowed.
